name: rota-logistica-platform
description: Plataforma integrada de gestao logistica: app Android para motoristas + painel web administrativo + backend NestJS/Prisma/PostgreSQL+PostGIS.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @rota/shared && npm run typecheck -w @rota/api && npm run typecheck -w @rota/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @rota/api && npm run lint -w @rota/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @rota/api && npm run test -w @rota/web
